## Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

# The Role

We’re seeking **Outbound Account Executive’s** to join our sales team at CompanyCam! In this role, you’ll drive high value deals within mid-market and enterprise companies, expertly navigating complex sales cycles and engaging multiple stakeholders. By building strong relationships with C-suite executives, VPs and Directors, you’ll uncover key pain points and position CompanyCam as an essential operational tool. You’ll drive outbound strategy, leveraging diverse channels such as ABM, LinkedIn, events, and creative outreach to connect with key decision makers in mid-market and enterprise organizations. If you’re a pro at enterprise strategy and closing strategic deals, keep reading and apply below!

**Location:** **Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States and in one of the territories listed below**. Employees are not required to work in the office or relocate to Lincoln, Nebraska, for this opportunity. Employees are encouraged to come hang at headquarters for up to 10 days per calendar year on CompanyCam’s dime. Employees will be expected to travel within their assigned territory **5 to 7 times per quarter.**

**Territory Breakdown:**

- **West Coast:** CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, NV, WY, AZ ( **AZ and CA strongly preferred)**
- **Northeast:** NY, NJ, MA, CT, PA, RI, VT, NH, ME ( **NJ and PA strongly preferred)**
- **Southeast:** FL, GA, SC, NC, AL, MS, TN, KY ( **FL and GA strongly preferred)**

## **What You'll Do**

- **Strategically prospect** and **multithread** across Operations, Finance, IT, and Procurement, focusing on building strong relationships senior decision-makers.
- **Conduct high-impact discovery calls** to uncover financially quantified pain points and tie solutions directly to business outcomes.
- Lead **tailored demos** to multi-departmental stakeholders, and clearly position CompanyCam as an essential operational tool.
- **Negotiate multi-year, high-value contracts** while working closely with legal, finance, and procurement to ensure smooth contract execution.
- **Own full-cycle deal progression** for high-value mid-market and enterprise deals, managing multi-stage sales cycles that typically last 1-6 months.
- Partner with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure seamless post-sale transitions and long-term customer success.
- Consistently hit and exceed revenue targets, with performance tied to quarterly revenue goals.
- Represent CompanyCam at key events and **build meaningful in-person relationships** with enterprise-level customers.
- **Travel 5-7 times per quarter** to attend trade shows and attend key client meetings within your assigned territory.

## **What You'll Bring**

- **3+ years of outbound sales experience**, preferably in a SaaS environment, with a proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding sales quotas
- **Proven ability to engage senior decision-makers**, multithread across departments, and drive complex deals forward.
- Experience managing multi-stage procurement, legal, and IT/security reviews.
- Strong financial acumen and **expertise in “pain-by-numbers” discovery** \- tying customer pain points to tangible business outcomes.
- Ability to recognize integration opportunities and collaborate with external partners to navigate complex deals.
- Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams to improve product-market fit, marketing positioning, and data strategies.
- Experience with tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and CPQ tools.
- A strong ability to manage and prioritize activities across multiple strategic accounts.
- A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
- A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

## Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. The salary range for this position is **$70,000 - $90,000** per year and is based on experience. Our average on target earnings (OTE) are around **$170,000 - $190,000**. We also offer meaningful equity and other [benefits](https://companycam.com/careers#Benefits).

_We pride ourselves on celebrating everyone. CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer actively working on creating an inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive. Are you reading this and wondering if you meet **every** requirement? Studies show that workplace minorities, such as women and people of color, are less likely than other applicants to apply for a job when they don’t meet every single requirement. **Even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align, we encourage you to apply.** We’re interested in hiring passionate, hard-working people—not checking boxes._

_For any accommodations or adjustments to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please email [jobs@companycam.com](https://jobs.investnebraska.com/companies/companycam/jobs/50607845-account-executive-outbound#) and we’ll respond to your email promptly. Do not include any medical or health information in your email._
